exceptions.authority: D8/D9; preserve existing PPC teaching interactions
exceptions.allowance: Named goods, numeric coordinates, existing vertical-title orientation and draggable points.
exceptions.boundary: No stylesheet override of fixed shared geometry, colour meaning, labels or pointer-coordinate calculation. Presentation transform must preserve/invert existing coordinates correctly.

exceptions.authority: User original scope and Stage 1 intentional differences
exceptions.allowance: Numeric elasticity markers/classifications; existing elasticity-specific curve geometry.
exceptions.boundary: Do not replace economic slopes, pivots, ranges, endpoints or response formulas with shared model logic.

exceptions.allowance: Existing step counts, explanation position, focus muting and navigation; narrow four-case button grid.
exceptions.boundary: No changes to step order, explanatory text, default state, focus behaviour or muted/unmuted teaching semantics.

exceptions.allowance: Existing semantic curve/area colours, contextual glossary colour emphasis, grayscale patterns and intentional initial/new contrast.
exceptions.boundary: Royal blue applies to interface accents, not compulsory recolouring of every economic curve.

exceptions.authority: Original teaching scope; D8 permits justified model-specific presentation
exceptions.allowance: Existing labour, quota, ban, free/joint provision and correction scenes and contextual labels.
exceptions.boundary: Any wider viewBox, nonuniform scale or alternate geometry needs a concrete presentation adapter and documented evidence. This scope allowance does not pre-approve an unspecified geometry override.
